# Tokyo Business Trip Plan, 2026-03-10 to 2026-03-12

A compact 3-day schedule built around a **Tokyo Station** hotel, **no meetings before 10:00**, and a total trip budget target of **under USD 1,200** for 1 adult.
I’ve kept each day balanced with work blocks, a **90-minute meal window**, and a **60-minute sightseeing break**.

## Day-by-Day Schedule and Budget Fit

| Day | Time Blocks | Focus | Estimated Cost |
|---|---|---|---|
| Mar 10, Tue | 07:00–09:30 arrival/check-in; 10:00–12:00 meeting; 12:00–13:30 lunch; 14:00–17:30 work; 18:00–19:00 sightseeing; 19:30–21:00 dinner | Arrival + first meetings | USD 260–380 |
| Mar 11, Wed | 08:00–09:30 breakfast/admin; 10:00–12:30 meeting; 12:30–14:00 lunch; 14:30–18:00 work; 18:15–19:15 sightseeing; 19:30–21:00 dinner | Full workday | USD 180–260 |
| Mar 12, Thu | 08:00–09:30 checkout prep/admin; 10:00–12:00 meeting; 12:00–13:30 lunch; 14:00–16:30 work; 16:45–17:45 sightseeing; 18:00 onward departure | Wrap-up + departure | USD 140–220 |

## 3-Day Itinerary for Tokyo Station Area

### Day 1: Arrival, Setup, and Central Tokyo Start
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg
- **07:00–09:30**: Arrive in Tokyo, transfer to a hotel near **Tokyo Station**, store luggage, and check in if available.
- **10:00–12:00**: First business meeting or focused work block.
- **12:00–13:30**: Meal block near Tokyo Station, ideal for a quick set lunch or business lunch.
- **14:00–17:30**: Afternoon meetings, calls, or laptop work.
- **18:00–19:00**: Local sightseeing block: **Marunouchi / Tokyo Station red-brick exterior** and nearby plaza walk.
- **19:30–21:00**: Dinner and early night to recover from travel.

### Day 2: Core Business Day with Light Local Time
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/briefcase.svg
- **08:00–09:30**: Breakfast, email, and prep for the day.
- **10:00–12:30**: Meetings or client sessions.
- **12:30–14:00**: Meal block, preferably a sit-down lunch to reset between sessions.
- **14:30–18:00**: Main work block for presentations, follow-ups, or strategy sessions.
- **18:15–19:15**: Local sightseeing block: **Ginza** window shopping or a short walk through **Hibiya Park**.
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/9/95/Capitoline_Wolf_-_Hibiya_Park_-_Tokyo%2C_Japan_-_DSC09727.JPG Alt=18:15–19:15**: Local sightseeing block: **Ginza** window shopping or a short walk through **Hibiya Park**, Tokyo, Japan
- **19:30–21:00**: Dinner with a low-key networking option if needed.

### Day 3: Final Meetings and Departure
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/geo-alt.svg
- **08:00–09:30**: Checkout prep, packing, and final messages.
- **10:00–12:00**: Final meeting or handoff block.
- **12:00–13:30**: Meal block near the hotel or station for convenience.
- **14:00–16:30**: Closeout work: invoices, recap notes, and travel admin.
- **16:45–17:45**: Local sightseeing block: **Imperial Palace Outer Gardens** or a short **Marunouchi** stroll.
- **18:00 onward**: Depart Tokyo or move to airport transfer.

## Budget Plan for Staying Under USD 1,200

- **Hotel near Tokyo Station**: USD 120–180/night × 3 = **USD 360–540**
- **Meals**: USD 35–60/day × 3 = **USD 105–180**
- **Local transport**: **USD 25–60**
- **Sightseeing / incidentals**: **USD 20–50**
- **Business contingency**: **USD 100–200**
- **Estimated total**: **USD 610–1,030**

Recommended budget approach:
- Choose a **business hotel or mid-range hotel** within walking distance of Tokyo Station.
- Use **train/subway + walking** instead of taxis.
- Keep dinners simple on meeting-heavy days.
